OBJECTION_PRICE.name: Price / Budget Constraint
OBJECTION_PRICE.core_rebuttal: At $497/month, the system pays for itself with a single recovered call. For home service contractors, the average emergency ticket is $450–$1,200. Recovering even one customer who would have called your competitor immediately turns this into a net-positive profit center.
OBJECTION_PRICE.call_to_action: Try the interactive voice demo on your phone to see how smoothly it books the job before deciding.

OBJECTION_COMPLEXITY.name: Technical Complexity / Setup Time
OBJECTION_COMPLEXITY.core_rebuttal: There is zero software to install or hardware to configure. It operates via standard carrier call-forwarding: whenever your line rings for more than 4 rings or after 6 PM, it automatically forwards to the AI receptionist, which gathers the customer's issue and texts your technician immediately.
OBJECTION_COMPLEXITY.call_to_action: We can get your test line live in under 5 minutes.

OBJECTION_ALREADY_HAVE.name: Already Have an In-House Receptionist / Office Manager
OBJECTION_ALREADY_HAVE.core_rebuttal: Most of our contractor clients have an in-house receptionist. SkillsVital is built specifically for what happens when they are on another line, out on lunch, or closed after 6 PM and on weekends—which is when 43% of high-ticket emergency calls happen.
OBJECTION_ALREADY_HAVE.call_to_action: Listen to how it handles after-hours overflow by dialing our demo line.

OBJECTION_ROBOTIC.name: Fear that AI Sounds Like a Robotic IVR
OBJECTION_ROBOTIC.core_rebuttal: Our voice AI operates with conversational latency under 600ms, using real-time human tone inflections, speech interruption handling, and natural contractor terminology.
OBJECTION_ROBOTIC.call_to_action: Don't take our word for it—dial our live receptionist line right now to test it.
